module_summary: Two-entry spill register (A slice + B spill) decoupling valid/ready handshakes, with flush draining both entries and output muxed from B first.

anchors.name: valid_i
anchors.why: Upstream valid; with ready_o fills register A.

anchors.name: ready_o
anchors.why: Upstream ready, high while A or B register is empty.

anchors.name: data_i
anchors.why: Input payload captured into register A.

anchors.name: valid_o
anchors.why: Downstream valid, asserted when either register is full.

anchors.name: ready_i
anchors.why: Downstream ready; drains B or prevents B fill.

anchors.name: data_o
anchors.why: Output payload muxed from B register if full, else A.

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Flush request draining both registers and blocking fills.

anchors.name: gen_spill_reg.a_data_q
anchors.why: Register A data slice loaded from data_i on a_fill.

anchors.name: gen_spill_reg.a_full_q
anchors.why: A-register occupancy flag; gates ready_o, valid_o, a_drain.

anchors.name: gen_spill_reg.b_data_q
anchors.why: Spill register B data, loaded from A when downstream stalls.

anchors.name: gen_spill_reg.b_full_q
anchors.why: B occupancy flag; selects data_o source, gates ready_o and a_drain.

anchors.name: gen_spill_reg.a_fill
anchors.why: Load enable for A data and full flag.

anchors.name: gen_spill_reg.a_drain
anchors.why: Clears A full flag and triggers B fill.

anchors.name: gen_spill_reg.b_fill
anchors.why: Load enable moving A data into B register.

anchors.name: gen_spill_reg.b_drain
anchors.why: Clears B full flag when consumed or flushed.

groups.name: A slice register
groups.description: First stage holding register with full flag and fill/drain controls.

groups.name: B spill register
groups.description: Spill entry absorbing data when downstream not ready.

groups.name: Handshake control
groups.description: Derives ready/valid from occupancy flags; flush drains entries.

groups.name: Output mux
groups.description: Selects B data when B full, else A data.
